step.title: Headcount report in one hour

opener.speaker: dir_park
opener.line: I have a budget meeting at eleven, and I need a headcount report for the department. Can you have it to me in an hour?

step.context: Dr. Park needs a headcount report before her 11:00 budget meeting. Today is also the HCM transaction cutoff for the biweekly and weekly payrolls.
step.hint: Ask what the director actually needs for the meeting. It's often smaller than the request.

choices.text: Send a quick count by employee type now, and the full report on Monday
choices.feedback: Dr. Park only needed totals for the meeting. Five minutes of scoping kept your cutoff work on track. Next time: confirm the real need and offer a time you can keep.

choices.text: Drop the cutoff work and build the full report now, since the director asked
choices.feedback: The full report took two hours of your cutoff day, and the meeting only needed totals. Next time: confirm what's needed and when, then protect cutoff work.

choices.text: Hold it until after the cutoff, since transactions have to come first today
choices.feedback: Cutoff work does come first, but silence left the director walking into a meeting with nothing. Next time: a two-line reply with what you can send and when.

consequences.speaker: dir_park
consequences.line: I went into the budget meeting Friday with no numbers. A quick reply would have been enough.
consequences.summary: The director was left without a reply.
